○ A little about me

The question
behind the work.

✳

How do you take something complicated and make it useful to someone?

That question has followed me from financial-data products at Okra to enterprise AI at Barrel and inbound operations at Amazon. I like pressure-testing ideas, products, and systems with the people who use them. I want to know where a workflow breaks and what someone has to do to keep it moving.

I’m now pursuing my MBA at Cornell and learning to build software with AI coding tools. Echo and Dockflow are part of that learning: concrete projects where I can explain the decisions, test the behavior, and be clear about what still needs work.

Where I’m from.

I’m from Osun State, Nigeria. I grew up in Ibadan, Oyo State, studied at Obafemi Awolowo University in Ile-Ife, Osun State, and worked in Lagos. These days, I call Brooklyn home.
